summary.text: Erin Huntley is the Republican candidate for Florida House of Representatives District 45 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Democrat Leonard Spencer.
Huntley works in human resources and serves on the Board of Trustees for Florida Virtual School.

paragraphs.text: Erin Huntley earned a high school diploma from Western High School and a bachelor's degree and a graduate degree from James Madison University, according to Ballotpedia.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said her professional background includes roles with Walt Disney Parks & Resorts, JetBlue Airways and DECA Inc., in leadership development, education and human resources.

Huntley listed affordability as her central campaign message, including property tax reform, expanding vocational and other education opportunities that do not require large amounts of debt, and reducing insurance fraud to lower costs.
She wrote that she supports reducing homestead property taxes while protecting schools, emergency services and infrastructure, and described herself as the mother of a child with special needs.
